Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (person: self, other) x 4 (emotion: happy, line [control], neutral, sad) x 2 (matching: matching, mismatch), within-subjects; between-subjects in paper: anxiety group (GAD-7 <5 / >=5) and label set (self-friend / self-stranger)

exp1.detail: Data note (2026-09): GAD-7 scores available in raw (GADtrial items 1-7, 0-3 each); sum stored in subj_info GAD_total (subject 18139 missing items 6-7 -> NA). Participants are NOT split into anxious/non-anxious groups in Dataset_inf (subj_Group = All, user decision: GAD-7 is a questionnaire score without clinical diagnosis; groups in the paper are based on GAD-7 <5 / >=5, 42 per group, paper N = 84 vs data N = 102). Raw Inquisit 'group' column (1/2) has no correspondence to any paper factor. subj_Group in Dataset_inf = label set: self-friend (n=53) vs self-stranger (n=49), derived from the Label column (each participant saw either friend or stranger labels, no overlap); paper recruited 84 (half/half). GAD-7 not used for grouping (questionnaire score only). extraIV1 = emotion condition of the shape (happy/line/neutral/sad). Task column added 2026-09 (default self-matching); study-specific extraIV columns renamed to extraIV1/extraIV2 (semantics above); redundant/derived columns removed (raw keeps originals).
